targets: Evaluate if AirLLM v3.0.1 + torch-directml patches is the best technical approach for Intel Arc A770
Compare against alternatives: llama.cpp SYCL, native IPEX, upstream waiting
Identify material gaps in our implementation
materiality_rule: A finding is material if it would change the architectural recommendation or reveals a performance/capability gap >20% vs the best alternative
stop_rules: All peers aligned on same recommendation
candidate_description: AirLLM main (v3.0.1) + 4 minimal patches: (1) find_or_create_local_splitted_path detects single-file safetensors/bin in local dirs, (2) clean_memory() guards torch.cuda.empty_cache(), (3) setup.py adds extras_require for directml/compression, (4) device_utils.py from PR #271. Inference tested: TinyLlama-1.1B forward pass + generate() both work on Intel Arc A770 via DirectML (device=privateuseone:0), ~8.3 it/s.
alternatives_to_evaluate: A: Our approach - AirLLM v3.0.1 + DirectML patches (current)
B: llama.cpp + SYCL backend (Intel recommended, GGUF models, quantized)
C: IPEX-LLM (Intel native, ARCHIVED Jan 2026 - dead project)
D: Wait for upstream PR #271 merge, use AirLLM DirectML without patches
